adjudication.depicted_input: Figure 1a shows the CellWhisperer training schematic with paired transcriptomes and text, including generated sample descriptions/conversations and the joint multimodal embedding training path.
adjudication.rationale: The current crop is defensible for the listed pretraining route. It visibly includes the route-specific input objects and representations the paper says are supplied during training: transcriptome data, text/sample descriptions, and the multimodal embedding-learning mechanism. Atlas rules allow training-scope inputs and shared architecture figures when they depict the same input mechanism, so the crop need not isolate a separate inference-only interface or a single model box.
